We believe that moving to clean, economical energy is one of the most important steps in today's world, and we are committed to providing our customers with the best solutions.
about.section2: To help our customers choose the most suitable option, we offer equipment in a range of powers and capacities for homes, businesses and industrial sites. Our team consists of specialists who will assist you in the selection process and answer any questions about energy systems.
about.section3: We are confident that our experience and professionalism allow us to provide the best service in the sale, installation and maintenance of energy equipment. Thank you for choosing our company as your partner in energy solutions.

guide.title: Charging Station Selection Guide
guide.subtitle: Answer a few questions and we will show the models from our catalogue that suit your car and power supply. There is no need to buy a more expensive station than you need.

seo.title: Which Charging Station Do I Need? Selection Guide
seo.description: Hybrid or fully electric? 7 kW or 22 kW? Type 2, GB/T or Type 1? Find the charging station that suits your car in a few questions.

guide.banner-title: Not sure which station you need?
guide.banner-text: Find the model that suits your car in a few questions.

questions.usage: How will you use the charger?
questions.car: What type of car do you have?
questions.connector: Which charging inlet does your car have?
questions.phase: How many phases does your power supply have?

hints.usage: A fixed station is mounted on a wall; a portable charger travels with you.
hints.car: Plug-in hybrids and range-extended (EREV) cars count as hybrids.
hints.connector: Open the charging flap and look at the inlet. Cars imported from China usually have GB/T.
hints.phase: You can check this at your distribution board or ask an electrician.

reasons.hybrid: Most hybrid cars have a 3–6 kW on-board charger. A 22 kW station will not charge them any faster, so 7 kW is enough. With this station most hybrids charge in 3–6 hours.
reasons.type1: The Type 1 connector is single phase, so the 7 kW models are the right fit.
reasons.ev-three: The 22 kW models suit a three-phase supply and a fully electric car. The real speed is set by the car's on-board charger, so check its power in the car's documents. If it does not accept 22 kW, a 7 kW model may be enough.
reasons.ev-one: The 7 kW models suit a single-phase supply.
reasons.ev-unknown: Since the number of phases is unknown, we show the 7 kW models that also work on a single-phase supply. Have a specialist check your distribution board: with three phases the choice may change.
reasons.portable: The 3.5 kW models work up to 16 A and the 7.4 kW models up to 32 A. On a normal socket, reduce the current to 10–13 A and check that the socket is not overheating. A dedicated 32 A line must be installed by a specialist.

guide.unknown-connector: Send us a photo of the inlet and we will confirm which model fits.
guide.no-match: No model in the catalogue matches this choice. Write to us using the form below and we will look together.
guide.install-note: A wall station must be installed by a qualified specialist, who checks the line capacity and protective devices first.

service.safety-title: Why not to install it yourself
service.safety-text: A charging station works with high current, and solar panels produce DC voltage whenever there is daylight. A wrong connection can damage equipment and create a risk of fire or electric shock. Connection work should only be done by qualified specialists.

price.a: It depends on the equipment, the distance and the condition of the site. You will see the exact amount in the offer.

self.q: Can I install the station myself?
self.a: We do not recommend it. Connection work should be done by a qualified specialist, because a wrong connection is dangerous.

prepare.q: What should I prepare for a request?
prepare.a: For a charging station: a photo of the car's inlet and the number of phases. For a solar system: your monthly electricity use and the approximate size of the roof. We also need the site address.

warranty.a: It varies by product and, where available, is shown on the product page. For example, JinkoSolar panels have a 12-year product and 30-year linear power warranty, and Maven laser equipment has a 12-month warranty.

location.a: Write the address in your request and we will confirm the options and terms with you.
